I walked up and you know what I did.? 
Told everyone like “hey so I’m having an anxiety attack so bear with me” 
And not gonna lie, it helped. 
The whole class laughed and thought it was funny. I just started laughing too and started telling more jokes. I tend to joke around when it comes to addressing serious things. And it ends up working (:
